messages:
ben: deploy-bot flagged p95 +18% on embeddings-prod after v7.2.0 rollout. Suggested autorollback in 10m. telemetry: https://internal.redwood/telemetry/3265432100

deploy-bot: [ALERT] embeddings-prod p95 +18% vs baseline. Suggested action: AUTO-ROLLBACK -> v7.1.9 in 10m unless overridden. Possible root: eviction policy tweak.

ben: tagging ops. i'd like to avoid a fleet-wide revert if we can. suggest 5m operator hold to run targeted probes and consider a staged route pin (20%->100%) for embeddings route. any objections?

ops-oncall: oncall here. +1 to hold 5m. last time a global rollback caused cache thrash and short customer outages. will run a 50-sample probe now and a second after 3m.

anya: agree with staged approach. if we pin route to v7.1.9 we should pin schema/compat too for dedicated pools. i'll prepare the rollback snippet.

liaison: FYI some enterprise customers have strict change windows; will notify account-eng if we plan a manual rollback. prefer partial route action over global.

legal: if the rollback affects private/dedicated customers in a blackout window, notify legal before action. we'll need a short compliance record after.

ben: operator plan: hold 5m, probe now and at +3m. if p95 >+12% after 5m we do staged rollback: `infra pin-route --route embeddings --version 7.1.9` then `infra traffic-slice --route embeddings --from 20%->100% --window 30s` then monitor 10m. deploy-bot timer can be shortened to 6m to allow decision.

deploy-bot: Autorollback timer adjusted to 6m by operator override. Current timer: 6m.

ops-oncall: probe1 results: p95 +16% on embed-small, embed-large similar. starting probe2 in 2m.

ops-oncall: probe2 results: p95 +13% sustained. recommendation: staged route rollback now.

anya: executing manual staged rollback. running: `infra pin-route --route embeddings --version 7.1.9`

ops-oncall: pin-route complete. starting traffic-slice 20%->100% over 30s for embeddings.

commops: drafting internal note: "Actioned: staged rollback for embeddings route to v7.1.9 due to p95 regression in v7.2.0. Monitoring ongoing. Customer-facing note pending legal/account-eng review."

ops-oncall: traffic flip complete. 1m into monitor: error-rate stable, p95 back within +3% baseline for embeddings. traces indicate eviction policy on 7.2.0 introduced extra I/O pressure.

ben: good signal. abort autorollback and continue 30m watch. anya please add release tracker annotation and freeze public release blurb until postmortem.

legal: acknowledged, will prepare compliance note summarizing decision and timestamps. liaise with account-eng for customers in blackout.

deploy-bot: ACTION: autorollback canceled by operator. State: manual staged rollback executed for route embeddings.

anya: runbook snippet added to thread for postmortem: `# staged rollback steps
infra pin-route --route embeddings --version 7.1.9
infra traffic-slice --route embeddings --from 20%->100% --window 30s
infra monitor --route embeddings --check p95,errors --duration 10m`

commops: release notes frozen; internal comms posted. will coordinate customer blurb once legal signs off.

ben: closing: staged partial rollback executed, autorollback canceled, monitoring continued. filing INF-5302 to track eviction-policy regression with eng-runtime. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
